notes.title: Chinese Language Added! 中文版更新！
notes.notes:
Hey guys, a bunch of fans have translated Epic Battle Fantasy 3 and Epic Battle Fantasy Collection into Simplified Chinese.
If you're interested in playing these versions of the games, you can opt-into them in the Steam Client's "Betas" menu.
I was not involved in this project, but there are a LOT of Chinese users on Steam, so I'm happy to include this version here. (After the USA, EBF5 has more fans in China than anywhere else!)

The same team is currently working on translating Epic Battle Fantasy 4, which will also be available on Steam as a Beta option.

My future games - including [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2624670/Matts_Hidden_Cats/]Matt's Hidden Cats[/url] - will include all 12 languages that EBF5 had, and maybe some more.

-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

大家好啊，有一批忠实粉丝自发将 Epic Battle Fantasy 3 和 Epic Battle Fantasy Collection 翻译成简体中文了。
如果想玩到这些游戏的汉化版，你可以在Steam端对应游戏右键菜单的“测试版”位置开启它们。
我本人没参与到这次的汉化工作，不过Steam上的中国玩家真是 超 级 多，能有机会将这个版本带给各位我也很高兴。
（EBF5的中国粉丝数仅次于美国，比其它任何地方的都多！）

这个团队目前正在翻译Epic Battle Fantasy 4，同样将会以测试版形式在Steam端推出。

未来将会推出的游戏 - 包括[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2624670/Matts_Hidden_Cats/]Matt's Hidden Cats[/url]在内 - 都将和EBF5一样支持12种语言，甚至可能更多。
